verdicts.evidence: lines 549, 592, 672, 683, 688, 751-752, 775, 843, 847, 916-917: retry, Save name, role select, Remove, Try again, notice buttons, Send invite, dialog Cancel/Remove and switches all have handlers that call the api and update the view.

lines 538, 551-563, 645: name, members, roles, seat count and notification states all come from api.getTeam; missing lastActive shows 'Hasn't signed in yet' (502). No sample or leftover text; the only hardcoded copy is labels (892-897).
lines 834-836, 381: the remove confirmation names the member and the team in its title, states the consequence, and the confirm button repeats the name.

lines 316-325, 335-352: each task is one step with one or two short single-line inputs; roles and notifications save immediately (672, 916). No task has over five inputs, several steps or long free text.
lines 344-347, 810: invite role preselects Member, the lower privilege. Line 838: the remove dialog focuses Cancel, and the dialog has no form so Enter does not remove.
Brief lists six occasional tasks with none dominant; the screen is a settings page of three sections (313, 328, 369). Role change and invite are nonetheless done in place (672, 775).

lines 313-373: three sections map to rename, members/invite/role/remove, and notifications. Seat count (645) informs inviting (seat limit). Last-active text (696) and initials avatar (692) are row detail, not added sections or controls.

lines 322, 349: one .primary button in each self-contained form/card (Save name, Send invite). Line 307: one in the load error view. Lines 384-385: dialog has plain Cancel and one filled button. Row Remove is quiet style (680).

lines 110, 385: the dialog's Remove button is class 'btn danger', a solid filled red button beside an outlined Cancel (384), so the destructive action is the most prominent button in the dialog. Focus does start on Cancel (838) and the row button is quiet (112).

lines 650-653: invite fields disable when seats are full and the reason is shown as text under them. Other disabling is only during the control's own request (668, 682, 854, 935). Owner row omits role select and Remove (665, 679).
lines 508, 696: the only tooltip is a title on the last-active text giving the exact date and time; the visible text already states activity. No control depends on a tooltip.
lines 283-388 and all message strings (599-626, 731, 780-820, 864, 877, 950): no visible text mentions implementation, the request, mock data or unfinished features.

line 381: consequence of removal shown in the confirm dialog. Line 653: seats-full note at the invite form. Line 315: where the name appears, at the name field. Line 371: 'Changes are saved as you make them' at the switches. Each sits at its decision.

line 333: 'Everyone with access to this team, and their role.' says what the section is for. Line 371: 'Choose which emails the team gets.' tells the user how to use the section. Line 365: 'Invite someone by email above to get started.' narrates the layout.

lines 330-333: heading 'Members' with description 'Everyone with access to this team, and their role.' Lines 370-371: heading 'Email notifications' with 'Choose which emails the team gets.' Both restate the heading. Also 'Team name' heading over label 'Name' (314, 319).
lines 283, 314, 330, 336, 370 and message strings: plain headings and factual messages; no greeting, slogan, superlative, exclamation mark or congratulation.

lines 307, 322, 349, 358, 684, 836, 878: 'Try again', 'Save name', 'Send invite', 'Dismiss', 'Remove' (in the member's row, aria-label names the person), 'Remove <name>', 'Invite again', 'Cancel'. No OK/Submit/Yes/No.

lines 489, 666-670: roles shown as Owner/Admin/Member. Lines 892-898: notification keys mapped to plain titles with a humanising fallback. Lines 501-518: ISO dates shown as 'Active today' etc. No ids, enum values or codes are displayed.

lines 305-307, 626, 731, 780-783, 817-820, 864, 950: each error names the problem and next step in user terms (e.g. 'We couldn't save the new name... Check your connection and try again.'). err.message and codes are never shown.

lines 599, 626, 731, 781, 783, 818, 820, 864, 950: error text is neutral ('That does not look like a full email address', 'We couldn't remove ...'); no 'invalid', 'failed', 'oops', exclamation marks or capitals.

lines 363-366, 646-647: with zero members the list is hidden and 'No one is on this team yet. Invite someone by email above to get started.' is shown directly under the invite form in the same card (335-352), which is the next step.

lines 304-308, 540: a failed load shows its own view with a 'Try again' button. Lines 363-366: no members shows a separate message pointing to invite. There are no filters, so these are the only two causes and they differ.

lines 540-543 load error with retry; 623-634 rename error keeps the typed name; 795-820 invite error keeps the email; 730-733, 686-689 role error with Try again; 863-868 remove error in dialog with Try again; 947-953 switch error with Try again.

lines 289-301, 536: skeleton with role=status while loading. Lines 614, 674, 790, 853, 939: 'Saving', 'Sending', 'Removing' with spinner appear at once. Calls take at most about 3 seconds with one quiet retry (470-473), so no progress or cancel is needed.

lines 289, 311, 531-536: the loading view is shown while #view-content is hidden; the empty message and seat count live inside the hidden content and are only filled after the response (545-546, 645-646).

lines 185-187, 161, 246: names and emails use overflow-wrap:anywhere inside min-width:0 cells. Line 502: null lastActive shows 'Hasn't signed in yet'; 504 handles bad dates. Line 840: long names in the confirm button fall back to 'Remove from team'.
lines 577, 637-639: a beforeunload handler prompts when the team name has unsaved edits or a rename is in flight. Roles and notifications save immediately (672, 916).
lines 339-340: the only format-constrained field is labelled 'Email address' and shows 'name@example.com' in the field before any input. The team name only needs to be non-empty (597).
lines 319-320, 339-347: the rename form has one required field; the invite form has a required email and a role select that always has a value. No form mixes required and optional fields.
lines 592-609, 775-783: validation runs only in the submit handlers. Lines 579-582, 770-773: typing clears aria-invalid and the message; no input handler ever raises an error.

lines 324, 351: the message paragraph sits directly under the field row inside the same form and holds the error text; line 91 adds a border on aria-invalid. At 720px and below the fields stack (257, 259) so the message falls under the button.
lines 623-634: on rename failure the input value is untouched. Lines 795-801, 809: the invite email is cleared only on success; on any failure it stays, with the role selection.

lines 598-601: empty name sets aria-invalid, shows the message and focuses the field. Lines 762-768: every invite error sets aria-invalid and focuses the email field. Lines 320, 340: both inputs carry aria-describedby pointing at their message.

lines 322, 349, 475-476: submit buttons are enabled from the start and use aria-disabled only while busy; empty submits explain what is missing (599, 780). Send invite is also disabled when all seats are used, with the reason shown (652-653).

lines 594, 610, 614: 'renaming' flag blocks a second submit and the button reads 'Saving'. Lines 777, 785, 790: same for invite with 'Sending'. Lines 848, 851-853 for remove; 719, 931 for role and switches.

lines 614, 790, 853: buttons change to a busy label with spinner synchronously. Lines 722-723: role row shows 'Saving' at once. Lines 934-939: switch flips and shows 'Saving'. Line 837: Remove opens the dialog. Line 536: retry shows the skeleton.

lines 617-621: header name updates and 'Saved' message. Lines 804-812: new row appended with flash and a notice. Lines 870-877: row removed and a notice. Lines 727, 944: 'Saved' beside the control. Failures are stated in place (626, 731, 864, 950).

line 812: 'Invite sent to <email>' reports a background send. Lines 620, 675, 944: inline 'Saved' confirms server persistence that the unchanged control does not show. Line 877: the removal notice carries the 'Invite again' action.

lines 628, 686-689, 765, 865, 951-952: errors render in place and stay until the next attempt or edit. Lines 742-752: the notice with 'Invite again' has no timer and stays until dismissed. Only the plain 'Saved' texts time out (622, 729, 946).

lines 672, 716-738, 916, 929-958: role changes and notification switches run at once with no confirmation, and the same control changes them back. Removal is treated under FB-007 because access is lost immediately and the record is not restored.

lines 834-838, 381: dialog asks 'Remove <name> from <team>?', states 'They will lose access right away. You can invite them again later.', buttons are 'Cancel' and 'Remove <name>', and focus starts on Cancel.
lines 378-388, 830-839: the only confirmation dialog guards removing a member, which is uncommon and cuts off a person's access at once. Save, invite, role change and switches have none.

lines 947-953: on failure the switch is set back to the stored value and a message says it is still on/off. Lines 671, 730-736: the role select returns to the previous role with 'We couldn't make ... They are still ...'.
lines 378-388, 683, 837: the one modal holds a single remove/cancel decision and opens only from the row's Remove button.

lines 837-838: native dialog opened with showModal() and focus set on Cancel; Escape closes it natively except while the request runs (844); native close returns focus to the trigger; after a successful removal focus goes to the notice (888). Cancel is visible (384).

lines 313-373: the screen opens straight on the working sections in the brief's order (name, members, notifications); the members card is the largest block and nothing decorative sits above the tasks.
lines 282-285: the header is only the 'Team settings' heading and the team name; no hero, greeting or intro panel precedes the first card (313).
lines 331, 645: the one summary number, '<n> of <seats> seats used', tells the owner whether another person can be invited (the server refuses invites when seats run out, handled at 653, 818).
lines 362, 556-560: the member list has no filter, search, sort or column controls.

lines 320-349, 668, 679, 907, 911: all controls are native inputs, selects, buttons and a checkbox switch. Lines 837-838: native modal dialog. Lines 702-714: focus is restored after a row re-renders. Line 121: visible focus outline.
lines 133, 599, 765: error colour always accompanies message text. Lines 675, 944: 'Saved' is text. Lines 213-221: switch state also shown by knob position. Roles are text (666-670).

line 390: an aria-live=polite region exists on load. Lines 460-465 and calls at 541, 600, 621, 629, 728, 733, 748, 766, 866, 945, 953: every status and error is written into it. Line 289: loading view has role=status. Errors use polite, not role=alert.
No accordions, disclosure buttons, custom menus, comboboxes or tabs; the only choosers are native selects (344, 668) and the only overlay is a native dialog (378).

lines 253-272: at 720px and below the name row and invite row stack, member rows reflow to name/activity over role and Remove, dialog buttons stack full width; dialog width is calc(100% - 32px) (240); long text wraps (186-187).
